milestone: OIP v2.2E.1A — Deterministic Bounded Evidence Mirror Cohort Gate

implementation.admission_boundary: EvidenceMirrorPublisher.publish_nowait, before mirror handoff/spool and after a completed production acquisition response

manifest_contract.canonicalization: sorted mint list plus canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, trailing newline)
manifest_contract.immutability: Loaded once when an enabled mirror initializes; subsequent file edits do not mutate in-memory membership.

configuration.EVIDENCE_MIRROR_COHORT_MANIFEST: required only when cohort mode and mirror are enabled
configuration.phase_1_requirement: Both EVIDENCE_MIRROR_ENABLED and EVIDENCE_MIRROR_COHORT_ENABLED must be explicit; broad mirror mode is not permitted for Phase 1.

creator_global_behavior: The triggering acquisition's launch mint decides admission. A creator shared by a cohort and non-cohort mint does not widen membership; creator-global observations retain the existing envelope provenance and only the triggering cohort mint is admitted.

accounting.reconciliation: eligible = accepted + excluded + rejected; accepted handoff failure remains explicit rather than exclusion

safety.production: fail open: acquisition response is returned independently of mirror admission
safety.rpc: zero — local immutable set lookup only
safety.activation: none; all production Evidence flags remain OFF

validation.performance: O(1) immutable set membership; no network or database work on decision path

phase_1_readiness: READY_TO_RERUN after this narrow implementation is committed; an actual production manifest is intentionally not selected until immediately before the Phase 1 activation.
